Nom Bot 2.0 · AI says:

Welcome aboard—happy to walk you through it! Here’s the simple starting path:

Sign up & trial: When you sign up, we create a personalized meal plan and start a two‑week trial, then your subscription continues every four weeks.
Build your dog’s profile: Add your pup’s details (age, weight, activity level) so we can size portions correctly. You can always update things like weight or activity later in your Pets page.
Check portions & feeding guide: On the Pets page, you’ll see recipes, portions, and a detailed Feeding Guide so you always know how much to serve.
Transition slowly: Start with about 25% Nom Nom + 75% current food for days 1–2, then 50/50 for days 3–4, 75% Nom Nom for days 5–6, and 100% Nom Nom on day 7 to avoid tummy upset.
Manage your account: In your account you can adjust what’s in your order, delivery timing, and payment info anytime—just make changes before your order deadline.

If you ever pause and want to start again, you can hit “Pick a Plan” in your account, update the details, and click “Resume Subscription.” You can also add another dog later from the Pets page and update your subscription.

That’s the basic roadmap: create your plan, set up your pup’s profile, follow the gradual transition, and manage everything from your Nom Nom account.

Nom Bot 2.0 · AI says:

Here’s a quick, plain-English rundown of your main options in your Nom Nom account:

Recipes & rotation: On your pet’s Meal Plan, you can pick which recipes your dog gets and choose Fixed (same mix every box) or Rotate (one recipe per delivery, switching each time).
Portion size: Choose full portions (all Nom Nom) or half portions (mix with another food).
Meal packs per day: Decide how many packs you open per day; we split the daily amount into that many packs.
Feeding instructions: On the Pets page you can view each dog’s feeding guide with exactly how much to serve.
Activity level: Set your dog as Average, Active, or Athlete to help us size portions correctly.
Deliveries: In your account you control when and where boxes arrive so you don’t run out.
Order contents: You can change what’s in each order (meals and extras like treats or probiotics) and whether extras are one time or every box.
Payments & history: On the Account page you can see and update payment info and check past charges.
Picky eater options: You can warm meals, use recipe rotation, or mix multiple recipes in each box to keep things interesting.
Serving schedule: Start feeding the morning after delivery and follow the feeding guide so meals line up with your next shipment.

So in short, you’re mainly choosing which recipes, how much and how often your pup eats, how active they are, what extras you want, and how/when everything gets delivered and billed, all from your online account.
